top_pain_points.topic: 非交互(CI/脚本)模式下有效编辑被静默丢弃且退出码为 0，用户无法区分成功与失败
top_pain_points.summary: 在 --message/--yes-always 等无头模式下，aider 存在多个机制会把模型产出的有效编辑或命令静默丢弃，既不报错也不应用改动，进程仍以退出码 0 结束，导致 CI/agent 流水线无法识别'命令执行'与'输入被忽略/输出被丢弃'的区别。涉及 #5623(--message 传入以 / 开头的 slash-command 时 SwitchCoder 被 bare pass 吞掉静默退出)、#5706(整文件格式下响应仅提及无关文件名即整体丢弃有效多文件编辑)、#5486(未收录模型自动选用 whole 格式但模型返回 diff，合法输出被当作'无跟踪改动'静默丢弃)。
aliases: CI 中编辑被丢弃且退出 0
createSdkMcpServer tool validation rejects valid input
service init --force model 静默回归
turbo gen 生成器被阻断
zod schema conversion breaks SDK MCP tools
订阅 OAuth 5 分钟超时
边界检查扫描 dist 产物
非确定性输出导致缓存 miss
top_pain_points.review_reason: 三个 issue 指向同一用户可感知的核心痛点：在 CI/agentic/无头脚本这一主流程场景下，aider 会静默丢弃模型产出的有效编辑(要么整段命令被吞、要么合法多文件编辑被无关文件名误杀、要么格式不匹配被丢)，全部以退出码 0 结束且无任何错误提示。用户无法区分成功与失败，导致流水线误判、改动静默丢失、成本浪费，属主流程阻断且存在多个独立复现路径，样例链接可支撑。

source_issues.title: aider --message '<slash-command>' silently does nothing and exits 0 (SwitchCoder swallowed)
source_issues.evidence: main() 中 except SwitchCoder: pass，--message '/model gpt-4o' 打印 banner 后 EXITCODE=0 什么都没做；--message '/ask' '/architect' 同样静默 no-op。无头/CI 用户无法区分'命令已执行'与'输入被忽略'。

source_issues.title: A valid multi-file edit is silently discarded if the response merely mentions an unrelated existing file (whole/editor-whole formats, non-interactive --yes-always)
source_issues.evidence: check_for_file_mentions() 对模型自身输出做整文本扫描，响应含无关文件名即在 apply_updates() 之前丢弃整个正确编辑；--yes-always 自动确认导致多文件编辑全部被丢弃，重度时上下文炸裂整个会话什么都没应用。真实模型端到端复现：3 文件任务首轮完成正确仍两次零应用、零提交。

source_issues.title: Unlisted-model whole edit-format auto-selection silently discards valid diff-style output (no error, no tracked changes)
source_issues.evidence: 模型 id 未在 model-settings.yml 收录时自动选 whole 格式，模型忽略指令返回标准 unified diff，aider 把正确的合法输出当'无跟踪改动'整体丢弃且无任何警告；加 --edit-format diff 后同样任务从 0/3 提到 90% 首轮正确落地。真实仓库规模复现。

source_issues.title: ANY_GIT_ERROR silently catches programming bugs (TypeError, AttributeError, etc.)
source_issues.evidence: ANY_GIT_ERROR 含 TypeError/AttributeError/ValueError/AssertionError，22+ 处 except 多数不记录日志，编程 bug 被静默抑制，使调试更难并掩盖真实问题。

source_issues.title: ANY_GIT_ERROR catches TypeError/AttributeError, silently hiding programming bugs at 22 call sites
source_issues.evidence: 与 #5008 完全同主题的重复报告，同样指出 ANY_GIT_ERROR 在 22 处调用点静默截获 TypeError/AttributeError 等编程 bug。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Compact context always fails after exactly 60s — client-side timeout aborts a condensation the server then completes
source_issues.evidence: On slow/local models summarization takes minutes, but the POST is aborted client-side at exactly 60s and the UI reports failure while the server completes the condensation ~10s later. Verified deterministically against a real agent-server with a 70s-slow model; no timeout override is passed on either client branch.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Context meter stays pinned after a successful compaction once the condenser has its own usage entry
source_issues.evidence: After a successful compaction the context meter keeps showing the pre-compaction fill and reports that no tokens were freed, because usage metrics take the max per_turn_token across the agent and condenser LLM entries, and the condenser entry is stale-large.

source_issues.title: Compact Context fails with 405 Method Not Allowed
source_issues.evidence: Pressing Compact Context in the cloud canvas fails with HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed because deployed routing does not reach a condense-capable runtime; works on localhost but fails across production and staging.

source_issues.title: Schedule name required in builder but not enforced in scheduling tool — causes 500
source_issues.evidence: Form submits but backend returns 500 because Schedule Name missing; user gets silent/confusing 500 with no indication what went wrong.

source_issues.title: Scheduled time and Actual run time do not match
source_issues.evidence: User reports weekly schedule runs on the following day: scheduled every Saturday but runs every Sunday — off-by-one weekday bug.

top_pain_points.topic: git 提交默认静默绕过 pre-commit 钩子，隐患代码/密钥可被直接推进 commit 历史
top_pain_points.summary: aider 的 --git-commit-verify 默认 False，commit 时无条件追加 --no-verify，绕过仓库配置的 SAST、密钥泄露扫描、格式化等 pre-commit 检查。当 LLM 生成问题/恶意代码(如注入)或夹带硬编码 API key 时，会被静默直接写入 git 历史而无任何警告。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 虽为安全相关，但存在明确的用户影响证据而非泛化公告：默认配置会使依赖 pre-commit(SAST/密钥扫描)的代码库在 AI 自动提交时失去防线，含有问题代码或硬编码密钥的改动被静默进入历史，用户直到事后才发现，属安全防线失效的用户痛点。

source_issues.title: Security Risk: Aider silently bypasses pre-commit hooks by default (--no-verify)
source_issues.evidence: args.py 默认 False，repo.py commit 时 if not self.git_commit_verify 追加 --no-verify；LLM 生成恶意/含密钥代码时绕过仓库安全防线静默推进 git 历史。

source_issues.title: Cross-Organization Agent Scheduling Without Authorization Check
source_issues.evidence: POST /api/agentexecutions/schedule -> schedule_existing_agent 端点接受 agent_id 参数，但未验证代理是否属于认证用户的组织；复现步骤明确展示：以组织 B 用户身份修改 agent_id 为组织 A 的代理 ID 后请求成功返回 schedule_id，组织 A 受害代理上出现攻击者选择的调度执行记录（CWE-284 不当访问控制）。

source_issues.title: Goose 1.38.0: Network error 'Could not connect to <host>:<port>' for a custom LLM provider is a hard, non-recoverable failure in Desktop — only restarting the app unblocks the session
source_issues.evidence: 自托管 vLLM/LM Studio 等自定义 provider 连接失败是硬性不可恢复错误，重发消息与切换 provider 均无效，唯一恢复方式是完整重启应用。curl 证明端点始终健康（~3ms HTTP 401），属客户端连接/传输失败，且 retry 逻辑在 Desktop/ACP 路径未生效。

source_issues.title: claude-acp fails to initialize under a managed policy that disables bypassPermissions
source_issues.evidence: 托管策略禁用 bypassPermissions 时，session/set_mode 请求被拒且不降级到 acceptEdits/default 等允许模式，provider 初始化直接失败，会话无法建立。

source_issues.title: Entity memory learning_id is not tenant-scoped: upsert silently overwrites another user's entity (cross-tenant data leak/loss)
source_issues.evidence: EntityMemoryStore id excludes user_id; writes global, reads per-tenant → user B's create overwrites user A's content (both leak and loss). Hit in production: 3 clobbered rows, one belonged to a real user.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Default-enabled clear_memory tool wipes every user's memories (unscoped db.clear_memories())
source_issues.evidence: Default LLM tool calls db.clear_memories() = unconditional table.delete(); a single agent session can destroy all users' long-term memory. Repro shows alice and bob both wiped.

source_issues.title: [Security] AgentOS create-run endpoints honor caller-supplied run_id; conflicting IDs silently overwrite existing runs (cross-user)
source_issues.evidence: Caller-supplied run_id allows overwriting existing runs cross-user in AgentOS create-run endpoints.

source_issues.title: MongoDb bulk upserts skip the session owner check, letting one user overwrite another's session
source_issues.evidence: MongoDb bulk upsert path lacks session owner check, letting one user overwrite another user's session.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Agent orchestration executes model-requested tool calls without a default confirmation gate, allowing arbitrary code execution (CWE-913, CVSS 9.8)
source_issues.evidence: Default PythonTools leaves requires_confirmation_tools=[] and all per-tool pause flags off; PoC (23 assertions) writes a marker via exec() with no confirmation. Affected agno <= 3.0.6, no patch.

source_issues.title: v3 CUA: CDP -32000 "Cannot find context" race condition during page navigation
source_issues.evidence: 占位，见 2945 与 3002 本主题证据。

top_pain_points.topic: find_capability 能力检索漏掉 skills/正确 block，导致 Copilot 选错工具或错误路由
top_pain_points.summary: 能力检索（find_capability）未把 skills 纳入候选，且对部分 block 检索排名错误，导致正好匹配的 skill 或最合适 block 不返回，Copilot 只能选择次优工具走错误路线，甚至失败后重试或产生错误结果
top_pain_points.review_reason: 能力检索是 Copilot 决定下一步调用哪个工具的必经入口，检索漏掉正好匹配的 skill 或正确 block，会让 Copilot 选择次优/错误工具，实际生产轨迹中出现失败一次再重试、错误路由的情况，既降低结果质量又增加不必要的成本消耗，是用户可直接感受到的智能体行为缺陷。

source_issues.title: find_capability doesn't search skills
source_issues.evidence: find_capability searches only tool/block/mcp_server; a skill written exactly for the task never appears. Production turn: team Linear skill existed but copilot followed MCP route, failed once, retried.

source_issues.title: find_capability misses FileStoreBlock for "save file output"
source_issues.evidence: find_capability("save file output") should return FileStoreBlock but top 5 are web-request blocks; nothing in top five stores a file.

source_issues.title: Experts: per-expert skill budget — rename, raise to 650, and make skills searchable via find_capability
source_issues.evidence: Skills left out of find_capability entirely; find_capability('triage a ticket') returns raw blocks and never surfaces the matching triage skill, even though it is the better answer.

source_issues.title: Model ID mismatch in AITextSummarizerBlock for Claude 4.7 aliases
source_issues.evidence: After v0.6.58, users selecting new Claude Opus 4.7 in builder see BlockUnknownError; backend AITextSummarizerBlock/AIListGeneratorBlock fail to map internal alias to provider ID, resulting in 400 invalid model ID from Anthropic/OpenRouter proxy.

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: AIListGeneratorBlock 400 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 is not a valid model ID'
source_issues.evidence: BlockUnknownError raised by AIListGeneratorBlock with message: Error calling LLM: Error code 400 - 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 is not a valid model ID'.

source_issues.title: jsonSchemaOutputFormat drops constraints for array-form types (nullable objects)
source_issues.evidence: 可复现的空对象/可空字符串/可空数组的 schema 约束（properties、required、additionalProperties、minLength、format）被丢弃转成描述文本，SDK 0.128.0 上 main 分支可复现，已提交修复 #1211 及 8 个回归测试

source_issues.title: Control-request failures raise a bare Exception rather than a ClaudeSDKError subclass
source_issues.evidence: toggle_mcp_server 应答 error 时 raise Exception('server not found')，isinstance(e, ClaudeSDKError) 为 False，调用方只能捕 Exception 处理协议失败。

source_issues.title: elicitation and request_user_dialog control requests are answered with an error; supportedDialogKinds and perTaskStopAffordance are never sent
source_issues.evidence: elicitation 请求被回 Unsupported control request subtype: elicitation；不声明 perTaskStopAffordance 导致中断时后台任务被 kill。

source_issues.title: Agent App registered as an MCP server: every tools/call fails
source_issues.evidence: tools/call 返回 error -32602 'Agent App only supports streaming mode'；streaming 开启动后解析只累积 agent_thought，Agent App 在 message 频道发布 answer，导致空 answer。

source_issues.title: Agent App MCP tool schema ignores Agent Soul app variables (required ones fail every tools/call)
source_issues.evidence: tools/list schema 仅含 query，Agent Soul 声明的必填 branch_id 未暴露，运行时校验报 'branch_id is required in input form'。

signals.topic: 非交互(CI/脚本)模式下有效编辑被静默丢弃且退出码为 0，用户无法区分成功与失败
signals.summary: 在 --message/--yes-always 等无头模式下，aider 存在多个机制会把模型产出的有效编辑或命令静默丢弃，既不报错也不应用改动，进程仍以退出码 0 结束，导致 CI/agent 流水线无法识别'命令执行'与'输入被忽略/输出被丢弃'的区别。涉及 #5623(--message 传入以 / 开头的 slash-command 时 SwitchCoder 被 bare pass 吞掉静默退出)、#5706(整文件格式下响应仅提及无关文件名即整体丢弃有效多文件编辑)、#5486(未收录模型自动选用 whole 格式但模型返回 diff，合法输出被当作'无跟踪改动'静默丢弃)。
aliases: CI 中编辑被丢弃且退出 0
signals.review_reason: 三个 issue 指向同一用户可感知的核心痛点：在 CI/agentic/无头脚本这一主流程场景下，aider 会静默丢弃模型产出的有效编辑(要么整段命令被吞、要么合法多文件编辑被无关文件名误杀、要么格式不匹配被丢)，全部以退出码 0 结束且无任何错误提示。用户无法区分成功与失败，导致流水线误判、改动静默丢失、成本浪费，属主流程阻断且存在多个独立复现路径，样例链接可支撑。

source_issues.title: aider --message '<slash-command>' silently does nothing and exits 0 (SwitchCoder swallowed)
source_issues.evidence: main() 中 except SwitchCoder: pass，--message '/model gpt-4o' 打印 banner 后 EXITCODE=0 什么都没做；--message '/ask' '/architect' 同样静默 no-op。无头/CI 用户无法区分'命令已执行'与'输入被忽略'。

source_issues.title: A valid multi-file edit is silently discarded if the response merely mentions an unrelated existing file (whole/editor-whole formats, non-interactive --yes-always)
source_issues.evidence: check_for_file_mentions() 对模型自身输出做整文本扫描，响应含无关文件名即在 apply_updates() 之前丢弃整个正确编辑；--yes-always 自动确认导致多文件编辑全部被丢弃，重度时上下文炸裂整个会话什么都没应用。真实模型端到端复现：3 文件任务首轮完成正确仍两次零应用、零提交。

source_issues.title: Unlisted-model whole edit-format auto-selection silently discards valid diff-style output (no error, no tracked changes)
source_issues.evidence: 模型 id 未在 model-settings.yml 收录时自动选 whole 格式，模型忽略指令返回标准 unified diff，aider 把正确的合法输出当'无跟踪改动'整体丢弃且无任何警告；加 --edit-format diff 后同样任务从 0/3 提到 90% 首轮正确落地。真实仓库规模复现。

signals.topic: ANY_GIT_ERROR 元组含通用异常，静默吞掉编程 bug 使调试困难
signals.summary: aider/repo.py 的 ANY_GIT_ERROR 异常元组把 TypeError、AttributeError、ValueError、AssertionError 等通用 Python 异常与 git 异常混在一起，22+ 处的 except 分支(多数无日志)会把这些编程缺陷静默吞掉，掩盖真实问题并延长了崩溃的暴露时间。
signals.review_reason: 宽泛异常捕获会导致真实编程错误在用户会话中被静默吞掉，表现为难以排查的间歇性无声失败，用户无法获得报错定位问题，降低可用性与可诊断性。两条重复 issue(同一 root cause)强化了该问题普遍存在，属用户可感知的可靠性痛点。

source_issues.title: ANY_GIT_ERROR silently catches programming bugs (TypeError, AttributeError, etc.)
source_issues.evidence: ANY_GIT_ERROR 含 TypeError/AttributeError/ValueError/AssertionError，22+ 处 except 多数不记录日志，编程 bug 被静默抑制，使调试更难并掩盖真实问题。

source_issues.title: ANY_GIT_ERROR catches TypeError/AttributeError, silently hiding programming bugs at 22 call sites
source_issues.evidence: 与 #5008 完全同主题的重复报告，同样指出 ANY_GIT_ERROR 在 22 处调用点静默截获 TypeError/AttributeError 等编程 bug。

signals.topic: git 提交默认静默绕过 pre-commit 钩子，隐患代码/密钥可被直接推进 commit 历史
signals.summary: aider 的 --git-commit-verify 默认 False，commit 时无条件追加 --no-verify，绕过仓库配置的 SAST、密钥泄露扫描、格式化等 pre-commit 检查。当 LLM 生成问题/恶意代码(如注入)或夹带硬编码 API key 时，会被静默直接写入 git 历史而无任何警告。
signals.review_reason: 虽为安全相关，但存在明确的用户影响证据而非泛化公告：默认配置会使依赖 pre-commit(SAST/密钥扫描)的代码库在 AI 自动提交时失去防线，含有问题代码或硬编码密钥的改动被静默进入历史，用户直到事后才发现，属安全防线失效的用户痛点。

source_issues.title: Security Risk: Aider silently bypasses pre-commit hooks by default (--no-verify)
source_issues.evidence: args.py 默认 False，repo.py commit 时 if not self.git_commit_verify 追加 --no-verify；LLM 生成恶意/含密钥代码时绕过仓库安全防线静默推进 git 历史。

signals.topic: wechat-mp 插件启用后导致 OpenClaw 网关启动死循环，端口不监听、网关完全不可用
signals.summary: 安装 @openclaw-china/wechat-mp 插件后，由于 shared 依赖包发布的是未编译的 TypeScript 源码（触发 ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING 无法加载），叠加主程序启动修复机制每次启动都判定插件缺失而无法收敛，网关陷入 systemd 无限重启循环，端口始终不监听，整个网关服务不可用。
signals.review_reason: 启用插件直接导致网关启动进入无限重启死循环，端口不监听、整个网关服务不可用（主流程完全阻断），并伴随插件无法加载的硬性发布缺陷。这是真实用户在使用中遇到的阻断性问题，具备明确的用户影响证据（退出码 1、systemd 无限重启、网关不可达）。虽然只有 1 个 issue 且为单仓，未达 P0 的 count 门槛，但因主流程被完全阻断、用户服务不可用，判定为 P1 保留。

source_issues.title: wechat-mp 插件在 OpenClaw 2026.8.1 上启用后导致网关启动死循环
source_issues.evidence: 发布包 @openclaw-china/shared@2026.4.24 只有 src/.ts 源码无 dist 编译产物，Node.js 22 加载时报 ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING 无法加载；启用插件后网关每次启动输出 Repaired missing configured plugin 后以退出码 1 失败，systemd 自动重启进入死循环，端口始终不监听、网关完全不可用。已排除端口占用、内存、DNS、防火墙及配置校验问题，禁用插件后网关立即恢复。

signals.topic: Conversations become permanently unusable or cannot be loaded after corruption, upgrade, or credential changes
signals.summary: Multiple distinct bugs cause existing conversations to become permanently inaccessible: after an upgrade old conversations throw 'Unable to connect to server' with a crash loop; a conversation corrupted by a VM shutdown returns a 500 'Missing event file' that is impossible to recover; corrupted data for a single conversation breaks the entire history list (forcing users to delete all local data); and conversations freeze resolved credentials so that rotating an API key makes every prior conversation fail with an unrecoverable LLMAuthenticationError. Users lose access to their own past work with little or no remediation.
signals.review_reason: These are user-facing data-access failures, not internal maintenance. In every case the user's past conversation work becomes permanently or semi-permanently inaccessible (unloadable crash loop, unrecoverable corruption, entire history list broken, or all pre-rotation conversations dead after key rotation), forcing destructive workarounds like deleting all local data. This is a main-flow blocker on core functionality (loading and resuming one's own chats) with direct user impact, spanning multiple independently-reported issues.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Old conversations cannot be loaded after upgrading to 1.21.0
source_issues.evidence: After upgrading to 1.21.0, opening an old conversation loops 'Unable to connect to server' with 'LocalConversation' object has no attribute 'agent' crash logs; new conversations work. User explicitly wants older conversations to remain viewable after upgrade.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Conversation corrupted after VM restart: "Missing event file"
source_issues.evidence: Loading a conversation after a VM shutdown returns HTTP 500 'Missing event file: events/event-...json'; reporter states 'Seems impossible to recover'. Corrupts a conversation with no recovery path.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Corrupted conversation data breaks the entire conversation history list instead of handling individual broken conversations
source_issues.evidence: A single corrupted conversation causes the whole history list to fail loading, and because IDs are raw UUIDs it's hard to find the bad one; workaround is deleting all local conversation data. Expected graceful isolation of the broken conversation.

source_issues.title: Conversation LLM config is frozen at creation time — resuming after API key rotation fails permanently with LLMAuthenticationError
source_issues.evidence: Each conversation resolves and persists the API key at creation time; after rotating a key every prior conversation immediately fails with unrecoverable LLMAuthenticationError, with no retry or user-facing remediation. Reporter observed ~13 conversations failing on one shared instance.

signals.topic: Compact Context / context condensation fails or reports misleading results
signals.summary: The Compact Context feature is broken in several ways: a hard-coded 60s client timeout aborts condensation on slow/local models even though the server completes it (UI falsely reports failure and the meter never moves); a 405 Method Not Allowed is returned on cloud canvas deployment because the route doesn't reach a condense-capable runtime; and after a successful compaction the context meter stays pinned at the pre-compaction value because usage metrics take the max across agent and condenser entries, so the UI reports 'no_change'. Users cannot reliably compact long conversations to free context.
signals.review_reason: Context condensation is a core workflow action for long-running agent sessions - freeing context when nearing limits. Users explicitly cannot complete compaction on slow/local models (false failure), on the cloud deployment (405), or get accurate feedback on the result (stuck meter). Each issue shows real user-visible workflow degradation on an important operation, though compaction failure degrades rather than hard-blocks all usage, so it is P1 rather than P0.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Compact context always fails after exactly 60s — client-side timeout aborts a condensation the server then completes
source_issues.evidence: On slow/local models summarization takes minutes, but the POST is aborted client-side at exactly 60s and the UI reports failure while the server completes the condensation ~10s later. Verified deterministically against a real agent-server with a 70s-slow model; no timeout override is passed on either client branch.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Context meter stays pinned after a successful compaction once the condenser has its own usage entry
source_issues.evidence: After a successful compaction the context meter keeps showing the pre-compaction fill and reports that no tokens were freed, because usage metrics take the max per_turn_token across the agent and condenser LLM entries, and the condenser entry is stale-large.

source_issues.title: Compact Context fails with 405 Method Not Allowed
source_issues.evidence: Pressing Compact Context in the cloud canvas fails with HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed because deployed routing does not reach a condense-capable runtime; works on localhost but fails across production and staging.

signals.topic: 定时/循环调度行为错误：提交报 500、周几偏移一天、暂停的调度被意外恢复
signals.summary: 定时调度环节出现多处用户可感知的错误：建立调度时未强制校验名称导致后端 500；按周调度出现周几偏移（如设周六实际周日执行）；重新雇佣专家会恢复用户故意暂停的调度，导致用户不想运行的任务被意外触发
signals.review_reason: 定时任务对用户来说应当是可靠、可预期的自动化，而这几个缺陷导致：任务根本建立不了（500）、在实际错误的时间运行（周几偏移，用户设周六结果周日才跑）、以及用户明确暂停的任务在无操作的情况下被重新触发。偏离预期会带来错过/多余执行，直接造成用户时间与成本损失，属于调度核心功能出错。

source_issues.title: Schedule name required in builder but not enforced in scheduling tool — causes 500
source_issues.evidence: Form submits but backend returns 500 because Schedule Name missing; user gets silent/confusing 500 with no indication what went wrong.

source_issues.title: Scheduled time and Actual run time do not match
source_issues.evidence: User reports weekly schedule runs on the following day: scheduled every Saturday but runs every Sunday — off-by-one weekday bug.

source_issues.title: fix(backend): re-hiring an expert resumes schedules the user had deliberately paused
source_issues.evidence: Pause a schedule, archive expert, re-hire — report starts firing again unasked. Cannot distinguish user-deliberate pause from archive pause.

signals.topic: 打开/渲染已保存的图在 Builder 中挂起或边被静默丢弃，导致图无法使用编辑
signals.summary: 用户通过 /build?flowID=... 打开已保存图时无限卡在 Loading Flow 转圈（所有 API 均返回 200 但前端不渲染）；AutoPilot 生成的图在 Builder 中边被静默丢弃、连接点状态与边不一致，图虽能执行但无法在编辑器中查看/编辑

source_issues.title: Builder hangs forever on "Loading Flow" when opening a saved graph, with all API calls returning 200
source_issues.evidence: Opening a saved graph via /build?flowID=... hangs indefinitely on the Loading Flow spinner; every API call returns 200, the data arrives, the frontend never renders it. Repro steps provided.

source_issues.title: AutoPilot-generated edges into dynamic dict outputs silently dropped in builder; handle connection-state desyncs from rendered edges
source_issues.evidence: Agent created by AutoPilot renders with missing edges and input handles showing connected with no edge attached; graph is confusing/uneditable in builder. 7 links analyzed, 5 silently dropped.

signals.topic: LLM 模型别名到供应商 ID 映射错误，导致 AI 相关 Block 以 400 invalid model 失败

signals.review_reason: UI 中可正常选择模型，但运行时 LLM 块因别名映射错误直接以 400 崩溃报 BlockUnknownError，用户明明选了新模型却无法使用任何 AI 能力，属于关键功能在执行时不可用，且在不同块/模型上反复出现（多起复现），用户无法预判何时会失败。
